notes.title: DLC content is incorporated into the game body
notes.content: The DLC content is merged into the game body, and you can play the game by opening it.

notes.title: Paradise of Desire Music DLC is available for free!
notes.content:
Free entry, download can listen
It contains six BGMS of different styles and one theme song
1. The beginning
2. Stare at girls
3. Endless battle
4. Meet a girl
5. Truth and Confession
6. Chase
7. Theme Song (Dark World)

notes.title: Minor BUG fix
notes.content:
1. Fix the main menu UI display
2. Fixed bug where monster names are not displayed in Japanese

notes.title: BUG fix
notes.content:
1. Fixed a BUG where achievements were reached but not unlocked, now they can be unlocked automatically by re-logging in the game
2. Fixed text display
3. Fixed errors in the display of text content
4. Optimized the volume of the ending video
